status: post-open source development; target objects remain sealed
claim_boundary: This protocol tests whether the official force-and-tool-only PokeFlex checkpoint supplies independent causal evidence that can improve the stronger released Kinect point-cloud checkpoint. It is an observation-fusion study, not a material-parameter or Causal4D counterfactual claim.

evidence_boundary.design_result: A CPU-only smoke selected the bounded convex proposal family after a 0.1 contribution reduced mean CD_UL1 by 3.43 percent against the released Kinect checkpoint.

causal_input_contract.robot_history: measured 3D force and T_WT tool position from frames f-5 through f-1
causal_input_contract.forbidden_method_inputs: frame f geometry, RGB-D, wrench, or any later observation

candidate_lock.family: convex interpolation from released Kinect prediction toward independently released robot-data prediction
candidate_lock.exact_fallback: scale zero returns released Kinect checkpoint vertices byte-for-byte
candidate_lock.final_admission_rule: leave-one-object-out source-calibrated upper regret bound; reject to exact fallback when unsupported

source_evaluation.aggregation: equal mean over frames within take, then equal mean over takes within object, then equal mean over objects
source_evaluation.selection: leave one source object out; fit candidate regret only on the other four objects

forbidden: opening any sealed target-object deformed mesh
using target-frame geometry to construct or admit a candidate
presenting a fixed blend selected on FoamDice_T1 as a transferable method
altering the frozen point-cloud or force-only checkpoint bytes
modifying any held-v8 artifact, operator, query, target, or score process
